title: A novel reconstruction-based method for unsupervised photovoltaic cell defect detection using electroluminescence images (PV-ReAD)
mechanism: EL-specific reconstruction AD with multi-layer adaptive fusion, adaptive noisy bottleneck against identity shortcut, and a global cosine focal loss.
adaptation: EL-native AD baseline for the benchmark; reimplement as Dinomaly plus their loss if no code; check whether U-PVEL-AD-seg masks are public as extra pixel labels.
min_experiment: Benchmark AD track only: train once on clean pool cells, report pixel AUROC / AU-PRO / relF1@2 per class; no kill line.
evidence: R: on new U-PVEL-AD-seg, image AUROC 95.2, pixel AUROC 99.7, AP 98.7, F1-max 93.6, AUPRO 77.8.
